achievements.name: Straight to the heart
achievements.officialDescription: Reach the center of the asteroid

achievements.name: Earth saved
achievements.officialDescription: Grind the asteroid down to zero

achievements.name: Wide awake
achievements.officialDescription: Reach the end without ever blacking out

achievements.name: Full toolbox
achievements.tips: The Lance and Slicer become available after you purchase either Orbital Strike or Collapsar. Whether they are required for this achievement is still unconfirmed.

achievements.name: Coffee break
achievements.officialDescription: Have a coffee before a shift

achievements.name: Gun on the roof
achievements.officialDescription: Mount your first gun on the ship

achievements.name: Quota met
achievements.officialDescription: Complete an order of the day

achievements.name: On a leash
achievements.officialDescription: Get pulled back to the lander by the tether

achievements.name: Demolition expert
achievements.officialDescription: Use all five charges from the workshop

achievements.name: Overtime
achievements.officialDescription: After the ending, take a contract on a new asteroid

achievements.name: Five-dollar massage
achievements.officialDescription: Turn on the massage in the dome chair

achievements.name: Bets are open
achievements.officialDescription: See every place on Earth through the telescope
achievements.tips: The telescope is located in the observation dome. Use its Earth view to look for locations; the complete target list has not yet been verified.

achievements.name: Rock rider
achievements.officialDescription: Ride a loose piece of rock while it flies

achievements.name: Low orbit
achievements.officialDescription: Stay in the air for 15 seconds straight

achievements.name: Quarter gone
achievements.officialDescription: Destroy a quarter of the asteroid

achievements.name: Apple core
achievements.officialDescription: Destroy three quarters of the asteroid

achievements.name: A million by hand
achievements.officialDescription: Dig out 1,000,000 m³ without the ship’s help

achievements.name: Squadron
achievements.officialDescription: Buy all four kinds of drones

achievements.name: Seen it all
achievements.officialDescription: Catch a meteor shower, a solar flare and a vein

achievements.name: Second wind
achievements.officialDescription: Keep going on the emergency ampoule

achievements.name: Hot lunch
achievements.officialDescription: Heat up a ration in the microwave

achievements.name: Fresh off the line
achievements.tips: A recent update fixed cleaning completion and made this achievement easier to unlock. If progress is stuck, make sure the game is up to date and follow the remaining cleaning highlights.

achievements.name: One more game
achievements.officialDescription: Finish a game on the canteen computer
